text: This report responds to direction from City Council to report to the Economic and Community Development Committee on steps that could be taken to ensure Toronto Community Housing tenants have access to a career in firefighting. Toronto Fire Services (TFS) has five entry level positions that are recruited with external applicants, including Operations Firefighter, each of which require specialized qualifications. Currently, TFS hires approximately 208 Operations Firefighters annually. In the last few years, TFS has made several changes to remove barriers for applicants, by adjusting requirements including removing expiry dates from certain stages of the Candidate Testing Service (CTS) process. Changes have also been made to the screening process, and interview process with a special program that ensures all qualified Toronto residents and/or members of equity deserving groups are invited…
The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. Received the report (June 19, 2024) from the Fire Chief and General Manager, Toronto Fire Services for information.
